discovery_notes: Follow-up 5 of B005 (packets 205, 409, 454, 487, 511). 28 standard searches, snippets only. New: Feb 22 PTN trio (Mr Crocodile, Michel, Jean; quoted passiondlp text), Apr 26 PTN trio (Guimauve, Oaken, Bulda) + Gus refresh pin, 20 Jul Pooh OE three (quoted dein-dlrp), Nov Frozen 2 two Elsa + three Stitch OE (summary), 10 Aug Abu OE + LE400 Thumper, 14 Juillet LE700. Sets only: Rendez-Vous Gourmand LE500 three (held), Phantom Manor event 13 Sep LE275 (unnamed). Corroboration: Sept medallion Maximus+Pascal, Thumper with family, Simba OE 8 Jun, Dinah/Pascal Aug 10 descriptions. No hold released.
